title: SIFT label borrowing: test images matched to train (inlier >= 5)
hypothesis: Some test images are other photos of the same scene as a train image; their label can be borrowed.

config.method: SIFT (300 kp, side 400) + Lowe ratio 0.75 + RANSAC partial affine, threshold 8 px

results.name: OOF proxy: train queries (corrupt+rotate) matched to other train images, inlier>=5, on EXP-024 ensemble

findings: Public +0.011 over EXP-022 (0.82164 -> 0.83262) from changing only 44 labels.
Precision of the borrowed labels is 100% on corrupted train queries for every threshold 3-30.
Coverage on test at inlier>=5 is 19.6% (393 images); on corrupted train queries 25%.
limitations: Proxy and public numbers are for different base ensembles.
Train-to-train matches include same-scene pairs; test matches may be looser.
